supplements.title: Dog and Cat Supplements
supplements.description: Joint, probiotic, fish oil and hairball supplements for dogs and cats, compared on format, ingredients and what each is meant for.
supplements.intro: Supplements come in powders, chews, oils and capsules, and the right format is often the one your pet will actually take. These guides compare supplements by what they are meant for and how they are given, and each one is plain about where the evidence is thin. Ask your vet before starting any supplement, especially for a pet on medication.
supplements.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on its label, format, owner ratings and what reviews say, and no health claim goes further than the product's own listing.

calming.title: Calming Products for Anxious Dogs and Cats
calming.description: Calming diffusers, treats, anxiety vests and other calming aids for dogs and cats, compared by trigger, format and species.
calming.intro: Storms, travel, a new home and time alone all unsettle pets in different ways. These guides match calming products to the trigger, from plug-in diffusers to treats and vests, and note which ones work only for cats or only for dogs. Results vary from pet to pet, and sudden behavior changes call for a vet visit first.

dental.description: Dental chews, dental treats and water additives for dogs and cats, compared on format, size and how easily they fit into a routine.
dental.intro: Most pets will never sit still for daily brushing, so dental products try to meet them halfway. These guides cover chews, treats and water additives, and each one weighs how easy a product is to use every day against what it is meant to do. None replaces a dental check at the vet.
dental.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on its label, sizing, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about daily use.

flea-tick.title: Flea and Tick Prevention for Dogs and Cats
flea-tick.description: Flea and tick treatments for dogs and cats, compared by format, species and how often they need applying.
flea-tick.intro: Flea and tick products come as collars, topical drops, sprays and chews, and the format decides how easy it is to stay on schedule. These guides compare options by species, format and application interval, and each one flags products that must never be used on the other species. Your vet is the right call for prescription options and for a pet with health issues.
flea-tick.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on its label directions, species and weight ranges, owner ratings and what reviews say about everyday use.

grooming.title: Dog and Cat Grooming Tools

grooming.intro: Grooming at home saves money only if the tool suits your pet's coat and temperament. These guides cover brushes for different cat coats, nail grinders and dog grooming tools. Each one notes what helps a nervous pet get through it.
grooming.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, coat-type fit, owner ratings and what reviews say about noise and handling.

outdoor.title: Outdoor Dog Gear: Picks for Every Season

outdoor.intro: Outdoor gear has to work on a hot sidewalk, a lake and a long afternoon in the yard. These guides cover dog gear for water, sun, heat and staying put, and each one points out the safety features worth paying for. Fit matters more than features here, so every guide covers how to measure.
outdoor.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, sizing guidance, owner ratings and what reviews say about real outdoor wear.

food.title: Dog and Cat Food: Picks by Life Stage
food.description: Kitten, puppy, senior dog, wet and grain-free cat food compared, plus the label lines that tell you whether a food fits your pet's age.
food.intro: The right food depends on your pet's age before it depends on the brand. These guides cover kittens, puppies, senior dogs and adult cats, and each one starts with the label line that shows which life stage a food is made for. Change foods slowly, and check with your vet before a big switch.
food.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on its label, its ingredients, owner ratings and what reviews say about how pets take to it.

treats.title: Dog and Cat Treats: Picks by Purpose
treats.description: Training treats, freeze-dried bites, lickable cat treats and seasonal picks, compared on ingredients, size and how pets take to them.
treats.intro: A treat does a job, whether that job is rewarding a sit, hiding a pill or filling a stocking. These guides sort dog and cat treats by what you need them for, and each one looks at ingredient lists, piece size and how picky eaters respond. Treats should stay a small part of the daily diet, so portion advice comes with every pick.
treats.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on its ingredient list, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about how pets take to it.

feeding.title: Pet Feeders, Fountains and Slow Bowls

feeding.intro: How a pet eats matters as much as what it eats. These guides cover timed feeders for busy days, fountains for pets who don't drink enough, and bowls and puzzles that slow down a fast eater. Each one weighs how much work the gear takes to keep clean.
feeding.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, capacity, ease of cleaning and what owner reviews say again and again.

toys.title: Dog and Cat Toys: Picks by Play Style
toys.description: Chew-proof dog toys, interactive puzzles, catnip, tunnels and snuffle mats, sorted by how your pet plays and whether it keeps them busy without you.
toys.intro: A toy that gets ignored after a day costs the same as one that gets played with for a year. These guides sort dog and cat toys by how your pet actually plays: chewing, chasing, sniffing or solving. Each one flags which toys hold up to a power chewer and which ones keep a pet busy on their own.
toys.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about durability and interest.

collars.title: Dog and Cat Collars: Picks for Fit and Safety

collars.intro: A collar has to stay on, stay comfortable and carry an ID tag every day. These guides cover collars for small necks, visibility for dark evening walks and breakaway designs that release if a cat gets snagged. Each one covers how to measure, because fit decides more than features do.

harnesses.title: Dog and Cat Harnesses

harnesses.intro: A harness spreads pressure across the chest instead of the neck, which suits pullers, small dogs and cats learning to walk outside. These guides cover no-pull designs for dogs and escape-resistant sets for cats. Each one starts with how to measure, since a loose harness is the one a pet backs out of.
harnesses.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on sizing, adjustment specs, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about fit and escapes.

These guides cover house-training supplies, clickers for marking good behavior, and deterrents that steer pets away from the places you want kept clear. Each one is clear about what the gear can and cannot do on its own.
training.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about results in day-to-day use.

A scratcher that wobbles gets ignored, and the couch takes the hit.
scratching.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on dimensions, materials, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about stability and wear.

beds.title: Dog and Cat Beds: Picks for Every Sleeper

beds.intro: Dogs and cats sleep most of the day, so the bed is the piece of gear they use most. These guides cover big-dog support, beds that run cool, and cats who want the sunniest window in the house. Each one looks at fit, cleanup and how well the bed holds its shape.
beds.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about comfort and wear.

crates.title: Dog Crates, Playpens and Crate Gear

crates.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on dimensions, build specs, owner ratings and what reviews say about setup and durability.

carriers.title: Cat and Dog Carriers: Picks for Every Trip

carriers.intro: A carrier your pet hates turns every vet trip into a fight. These guides cover cat travel carriers, bubble-window backpacks and backpack carriers for small dogs. Each one starts with how to measure your pet, because a carrier that fits is one they'll actually walk into.

travel.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, fit, owner ratings and what reviews say about life on the road.

cleaning.title: Pet Cleaning Gear: Hair, Stains and Odor

These guides cover the gear that deals with both, from lint tools and laundry hair catchers to enzyme cleaners and vacuums built for fur. Each one notes which surfaces a product suits and where owners say it falls short.
cleaning.how_we_choose: Every pick is compared on specs, owner ratings and what reviews say again and again about real messes and real fur.

Battery life and app quality decide most of the experience, so both get a close look.
